issue.title: SelectMenu closes immediately when tapping an option on iOS Safari
issue.body:
### Environment

- Browser: iOS Safari (real device)

### Description

On iOS Safari, tapping an option inside `USelectMenu` closes the menu without selecting it. The `change` event never fires. Works fine on desktop Chrome and Firefox.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/saralind/acme-select-repro

### Expected behavior

Tapping an option should select it and close the menu with the value applied.

### Actual behavior

The menu closes and the previous value stays selected.
